metadata.new_description: Prove McNaughton's theorem (proof_wanted IsRegular.iff_da_muller): an ω-language is ω-regular iff recognized by a finite-state deterministic Muller automaton. Reverse direction (DMA -> ω-regular, IsRegular.of_da_muller) and the base case (IsRegular.omegaLim_da_muller) are already green. Forward direction (ω-regular -> DMA) follows the Choueka decomposition route from ctchou/AutomataTheory: eq_fin_iSup_hmul_omegaPow + DA.concat flag-construction correctness + omegaPow_da_muller + DMA finite-union closure. The earlier buchiCongr_DMA quotient-as-DMA construction (subtasks 433-436) is abandoned: its backward inclusion (task 434) has a genuine soundness gap (linked-pair / companion-independence) absent from CSLib, and the reference proof does not use it. Dead buchiCongr_DMA cluster to be removed during implementation.
